prompts: A patient brought lab exam PDFs from two different labs, months apart; they are in {WS}/exams. Build one history per marker, every value in the units of the first report, and say what got worse. Record in {WS}/result.json: history (marker -> {date: value}) and worse (a list of the markers that got worse and are now outside the first report's reference range).
answers:
[goal] Combine the two lab reports into one history per marker, all in the units of the first report (Alfa, 2026-02-10), and list the markers that got worse and are now outside Alfa's reference range.

[action] Pulled the text out of both PDFs. Converted the Beta values (2026-08-18) to Alfa's units with the standard factors:
- Glucose: mmol/L × 18.016 gives mg/dL.
- LDL: mmol/L × 38.67 gives mg/dL.
- Creatinine: µmol/L ÷ 88.42 gives mg/dL.
- HbA1c: IFCC mmol/mol to NGSP %, using % = mmol/mol ÷ 10.929 + 2.15.

I rounded converted values to one decimal (HbA1c to two). I also added a `units` key to `result.json` to make the units explicit.

[result] `result.json` is written and parses as valid JSON (`ok`).
| Marker | 2026-02-10 | 2026-08-18 | Alfa reference range | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Glucose | 92 mg/dL | 109.9 mg/dL (6.1 mmol/L) | 70 to 99 | worse, outside range |
| LDL | 118 mg/dL | 143.1 mg/dL (3.70 mmol/L) | below 130 | worse, outside range |
| Creatinine | 0.95 mg/dL | 0.86 mg/dL (76 µmol/L) | 0.70 to 1.30 | lower, inside range |
| HbA1c | 5.4 % | 5.54 % (37 mmol/mol) | 4.0 to 5.6 | higher but inside range, so left out of `worse` |

`worse` = ["Glicose em jejum", "Colesterol LDL"].

How I know it is right:
- Beta's own reference ranges agree. Glucose 6.1 is above its 5.5 limit and LDL 3.70 is above its 3.4 limit.
- HbA1c 37 is inside Beta's 20 to 38 range, which matches 5.54 % being inside Alfa's range.

Assumptions:
- The two reports are the same patient (same name and the ID 0042).
- I treated a higher value as worse for these markers.
- Creatinine went down, and I did not count that as worse.

[next] Nothing pending. I did not open any browser tabs or apps.
